changeSet.author: ${claude}
changeSet.comment: holdings_overview carries the owner, the wallet identity and the gain arithmetic, so no consumer has to join finances.wallets or recompute gain in Kotlin (issue #241). CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW only accepts columns appended at the end of the list, so user_id, wallet_external_id, wallet_name, wallet_currency, gain and gain_pct trail frozen, which keeps holdings_report_rows alive without dropping it. gain_pct rounds the ratio to ten places before scaling by 100, exactly as the Kotlin it replaces did, so every payload keeps the same digits. The report view recomputes both from its own sums rather than averaging the rows underneath.
